label: About
title: About Measure Slits for a Silent Prize
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around YouTube Music Library and @kevin2kelly: Here in brief is the method I’ve honed to optimize a two-week vacation: When you..., plus 7 more. A source image from img.youtube.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Measure Slits for a Silent Prize: A silent prize field in a diagrammatic fold, shot as a side-lit object slab: vast matte off-white emptiness, one charcoal bass ridge along the lower third, uneven hairline measure cuts crossing like a procession. Two quiet hero dropout apertures open into compressed media depth; smaller glass plate-burn rectangles,... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against long black lower bass-ridge aperture, left vertical dropout slot, and upper-right glassy burn rectangle.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
